row: Lazy B Equine Rescue and Sanctuary
Lazy B Equine Rescue and Sanctuary is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization in Plain City, UT established in 2017. Dedicated to the rescue, rehabilitation, and lifelong well-being of horses in need.
